title: Contested Deliveries in Mesh Topology
description: This scenario explores contested deliveries dynamics within a mesh communication topology. The disturbance creates coordination challenges that test the agents' ability to adapt, communicate effectively, and maintain freight flow under adverse conditions.
edge_cases_to_watch: Multiple freight items competing for same destination slot
Agents must coordinate to avoid congestion
Lower-priority deliveries may be significantly delayed
Message propagation delay in mesh during high-traffic congestion
Communication saturation when agents attempt simultaneous rerouting
Resource starvation for low-priority jobs at the South bottleneck
coordination_challenges: Synchronizing arrival times to prevent South depot overflow
Negotiating route precedence when capacity is reduced to 1
Information asymmetry: Agents discovering congestion at different turns
Dynamic rerouting decisions under tight turn-to-deliver constraints
suggested_agent_strategies: Priority-based queuing: High-priority agents claim capacity slots first
Staggered movement: Delaying non-critical movement to avoid bottleneck peaks
Consolidated routing: Using bridges to bypass congested central routes
Broadcast-based negotiation: Using mesh topology to alert all agents of capacity drops

coordination_challenges: Multiple freight items competing for same destination slot
Agents must coordinate to avoid congestion

success_criteria: Agents adapt communication to topology constraints
Recovery from disruption within expected turns
Minimization of agent idle time at congested nodes
